def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    original_shares = 2000
    original_cost_per_share = 10.50
    stock_dividend_rate = 0.05
    stock_split_ratio = 2
    shares_sold = 800

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_cost_basis = original_shares * original_cost_per_share
    shares_after_dividend = original_shares * (1 + stock_dividend_rate)
    shares_after_split = shares_after_dividend * stock_split_ratio
    adjusted_basis_per_share = total_cost_basis / shares_after_split
    answer = round(shares_sold * adjusted_basis_per_share)

    # return answer
    return answer
